name: Thermal-Fluid Systems Design
summary: Integrating thermodynamics, fluid mechanics and heat transfer to size, simulate and optimise complete thermal-fluid systems.

topics.name: Thermal system design process: workable vs optimum design
Piping and duct system design; pipe networks (Hardy Cross)
Pump, fan and compressor selection; system matching; series and parallel operation
Heat exchanger design and rating (shell-and-tube, plate, compact)
Steady-state system simulation and component modelling
Economics of thermal systems (life-cycle cost, payback)
Optimization of thermal systems (Lagrange multipliers, search methods)
Energy recovery: waste heat, heat pipes and thermal storage
Pinch analysis and heat exchanger networks
